item_short_desc: The Rothco USAF Pilot Wing Pin is a meticulously crafted replica of the official United States Air Force pilot wings, ideal for veterans, collectors, and aviation enthusiasts. Made from high-quality metal with a durable finish, this pin ensures long-lasting elegance. Its secure pin-back closure allows for easy attachment to uniforms, jackets, hats, or bags. This pin makes a perfect gift for military personnel and anyone who appreciates military memorabilia and history.
